clauses.why: The verses tell of the children of Gad, the tribe, not Gad the son of Jacob himself.
The altar was built and named by the descendants, the children of Gad, not by Gad the son of Jacob.

answer.note: The line leaves out Gad's own birth and naming by Leah (GEN 30:9-11), the only event that concerns Gad himself.
